spans.s: श्व—प m. ‘keeper of d˚’, a possessor of d˚, Hariv.
sleeping, sleep, Suśr.; Kathās.; BhP.
dreaming, a dream, Prab.; BhP.
sleepiness, sloth, W.

loss of sensation, ignorance, L.
&c. See p. 1280, col. 3.
श्व—पक w.r. for -पच, Rājat.

Vārtt. 2

a dog-feeder, dog-keeper, W.
श्व—पची (ई), f. (cf. above)
a form of one of the Śaktis of Śiva, MW.
श्व—पच—ता f. the condition of a member of the above low caste, MBh.
श्व—पच—त्व n. the condition of a member of the above low caste, MBh.
श्व॑—पति (श्व॑-), m. a lord or possessor of dogs, VS.; MaitrS.; BhP.
